text:
sam_sales: AcmePoC reporting "pool bind failed" when attaching Dedicated reservation in europe-north. customer says reservation shows ACTIVE but pool stays in PENDING. anyone?
tanya_se: tagging infra. what does the failure log show? short clip please.
acme_poc_bot: reservation-create returned id rsv-1f2g3h4, status: ACTIVE. pool bind attempted: pool-7c8d9e. ProvisionAgent log: 
```
2026-03-18T09:10:22Z ERROR ProvisionAgent: BindFailed(pool-7c8d9e) - SubnetZoneConflictError: reservation region eu-north1, AZ eu-north1-c; subnet svc-eu-north1-b enforces zones [eu-north1-b].
```
leo_infra: looks like subnet is single-AZ. did the customer create the subnet with AZ restriction? which VPC template did they use?
sam_sales: they used our quickstart terraform module, subnet var: azs = ["eu-north1-b"] (they thought it's fine).
tanya_se: OK two probable fixes: 1) recreate subnet spanning eu-north1-b and eu-north1-c; 2) create reservation with azAffinity matching the subnet (eu-north1-b). Which do they prefer?
acme_poc_bot: customer prefers not to touch infra. they want pref not to recreate subnet. any option to change reservation AZ without recreation?
leo_infra: we don't support mutating azAffinity for an in-use reservation. However we have a migration path: create a new reservation with identical spec but azAffinity set to REGION (placement across AZs allowed) and then attach pool to it. Use scheduled activation to avoid overlap billing.
nina_ops: note: scheduling activation requires activation_time param. Also if REGION-wide capacity is low, the new reservation will stay PENDING until capacity frees. we can request a short-capacity hold for the migration window.
sam_sales: will scheduled activation avoid double-charge? customer worried about being billed for both reservations during swap.
leo_infra: billing semantics: reservation billing starts at activation_time. If you schedule new reservation activation after you deprovision the old one, there is no overlap. If you need warm-up, you can schedule activation for the new one at time T and schedule termination of old one at T+5m. That 5m overlap would be charged for both.
tanya_se: customer asks whether REGION vs AZ affinity affects performance.
leo_infra: small delta: AZ affinity can slightly reduce cross-AZ network overhead for storage mounts; for pure inference pods it's negligible. Preferred option is matching subnet AZ to reservation if they require strict AZ locality.
nina_ops: I'll open a capacity request with infra: "eu-north1 reserve ephemeral 4xA100 for migration window 2026-03-19T11:00Z-11:30Z". ticket #INF-8276.
acme_poc_bot: can you provide the exact CLI to make the new reservation with activation time? we'll run it.
leo_infra: sure, example: 
```
redwood-cli reservations create --name acme-poc-mig --region eu-north1 --az-affinity REGION --gpu-type a100 --count 4 --activation-time 2026-03-19T11:05:00Z
# then update pool binding
redwood-cli pools bind pool-7c8d9e --reservation-id rsv-5z6y7x8 --force
```
note: replace rsv-5z6y7x8 with the returned id. --force will attempt immediate bind when reservation ACTIVE.
sam_sales: customer wants step-by-step for zero-downtime. propose sequence: 1) schedule new reservation activation at 11:05, 2) during activation monitor provision logs, 3) once pool shows BOUND switch traffic to Dedicated, 4) decommission old reservation at 11:10. good?
tanya_se: yes, and add a temporary fallback route to Hosted for 10m in case bind delays.
acme_poc_bot: they asked where to set activation-time in Console.
leo_infra: Console -> Capacity -> Reservations -> Create reservation -> Advanced -> Activation schedule. There's a field "activation_time" and a toggle "schedule activation".
nina_ops: started ticket INF-8276 for capacity hold and set priority P1 for migration window.
sam_sales: i'll confirm the 11:05 UTC slot with the customer. thanks all.
acme_poc_bot: Confirmed, customer accepts 2026-03-19T11:05Z window. Will run CLI and ping here when executing.
leo_infra: I'll watch provision logs and ready to roll back. ping me as you run bind command.
acme_poc_bot: one more: customer asked about subnet change later — can we have our terraform module default to multi-AZ subnets?
tanya_se: yes we should update quickstart to make azs parameter multi by default and document AZ constraints in the Dedicated POC guide. I'll file a docs PR.
sam_sales: perfect. closing loop once migration complete. thanks team :white_check_mark:
